dialogues.speaker: Woland
dialogues.text: How wonderful the trains here in Snezhnaya are! Now, I won't have to take that much time to get to my dinner reception. If only we had something like this in Mondstadt too!

dialogues.speaker: Woland
dialogues.text: Yes, my friend. I am from Mondstadt, and I've been active in the Mondstadt chapter of the Adventurers' Guild for a while now...

dialogues.speaker: Woland
dialogues.text: I've been asked to make a few presentations at Guild headquarters, and I will meet a few friends on the side too. That's why I'm on this train.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You said something about a dinner reception?

dialogues.speaker: Woland
dialogues.text: Oh, that might be a bit of an exaggeration, I'd admit. It's really just a get-together between friends...

dialogues.speaker: Woland
dialogues.text: But it's a proper get-together nevertheless. The kind where you invite four friends you haven't seen in a while, as well as a writer and the woman he loves.

dialogues.speaker: Woland
dialogues.text: Look, it's not going to be easy getting all of these people in one room at the same time. But I think I'm gonna pull this off nevertheless.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.
